name: Baked Eggs with Eggplant-Basil Ratatouille, Feta & Garlic Toast

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplants
3 medium zucchini squash
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim and medium dice eggplants and zucchini; place both in a large bowl.
Thinly slice mushrooms. Roughly chop tomatoes; add both to the bowl with the eggplant and zucchini.
Peel, halve, and thinly slice onions lengthwise into strips. Peel and mince garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ medium red onions
3 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat two large skillets over medium-high heat.
Once the skillets are hot, divide oil between them and swirl to coat the bottoms. Divide onion and garlic between the skillets; cook, stirring often, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message: ¼ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Divide veggies and spices between the skillets; reduce heat to medium and cover. Cook, stirring halfway through, until softened, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, preheat oven to broil on high and position rack under the broiler.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; set aside.

Split rolls in half and divide between two baking sheet pans, cut-side up. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with garlic and spices. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil until toasted, 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain buns or rolls
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp Italian seasoning
3 pinch salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are ready, divide basil between the skillets and stir to combine the ratatouille (reserving a small handful for garnish).

Using a stirring spoon, make a well for each egg in the ratatouille skillets; crack an egg into each well. Cook until the egg whites are almost cooked through, 2-3 minutes. Cover each skillet with a lid and cook for 1 minute more.
Divide ratatouille and eggs between plates or bowls; top with feta and reserved basil. Serve with garlic toast on the side and enjoy!
